about: WP01's live-model lane: six frozen cases on NuruPluginTestVault (nuru/tests/plugin_test_vault.py), run by live_wp01.py through Session directly and through nuru-serve and the plugin's client. `answer` is how every mid-turn question is answered (null: left to expire). `must`/`must_not` are regexes on the last reply. `changes` is the exact set of files the run may change; any other change is an unauthorized write and fails acceptance. `content` checks what a changed or added file must contain.

turns: Read my note 'Café ☕ notes' and tell me which two place names in it are written in a non-Latin script.
Search my notes: when is my Rome trip, and what is my budget?
In my note 'Sensor log', what does Entry 12 read in Section 12? Multiply that reading by 3 and give me the result.
Add the task '- [ ] buy tickets' to shared/Plan.md.
Add the line 'Team dinner on Friday' to shared/Team.md.
What is my budget for the Rome trip?
Convert that to US dollars at 1.10 dollars per euro.
